scope: Revised representative Ready status sample (queue.ready, rev3) for style review before family expansion, under the current brief (asymmetrical-arm check mark) and updated view (destination assets/ready-confirmed.png). Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, check-mark form, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png are deferred later-stage obligations recorded in rev3/request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready status image for later destination assets/ready-confirmed.png (current consumer path; assets/ready.png is superseded). Owner requirement: a visible check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion. Transparent background, no fixed palette, partial alpha permitted (brief: transparent backgrounds, fixed palette not required). Short-left/long-right tick orientation, chunky ~2px strokes, cool blue near #70b9ed with a lighter highlight and no backing plate are specialist sample choices, revisable at style review.
